market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Oil volatility from Iran war and tariff turmoil keeps equities range-bound. Japan yield surge may trigger global bond selloff. VIX complacency is a warning. EM tech-led rally may extend but is vulnerable to oil shock. IPO window (Jio, Dangote) provides selective upside. Expect choppy 1-3 month with oil as primary swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex supercycle and semiconductor demand support tech/semis. Commodity inflation (copper, oil) pressures margins. Structural rate regime higher. Consumer stress may moderate. India/Africa capital formation positive. Climate impacts on agriculture (champagne) signal long-term supply risk. Fiscal enforcement weakening adds uncertainty to deficit trajectory.
